note: Personal install notes for Duty / LSPDFR only. Never used to write the official Online folder.

guides.title: Policing Redefined
steps: Install into the Duty LSPDFR folder only — never the official Steam / Online folder.
Use the files inside the pack’s “GTAV MAIN DIRECTORY” folder. That folder is the game root (next to RagePluginHook.exe).
The plugin belongs under Plugins\LSPDFR\.
Install RageNativeUI first if it is not already in Duty.
Install Damage Tracker Framework first if it is not already in Duty.
Do not run Stop The Ped and Ultimate Backup together with Policing Redefined unless you know they work together.
An empty Settings folder after install is normal. Go on duty once so Policing Redefined can create its files.

guides.title: Stop The Ped
steps: Install into the Duty LSPDFR folder only.
Put StopThePed.dll under Plugins\LSPDFR\.
Install RageNativeUI if it is missing.
Do not stack this with Policing Redefined unless you know they are compatible.

guides.title: Ultimate Backup
steps: Install into the Duty LSPDFR folder only.
Put UltimateBackup.dll under Plugins\LSPDFR\.
Install RageNativeUI if it is missing.
Do not stack this with Policing Redefined unless you know they are compatible.

guides.title: RAGENativeUI
steps: Install into the Duty folder, next to RagePluginHook.exe — not the official Steam / Online folder.
RAGENativeUI.dll belongs in the Duty game root (this manager can download the official GitHub zip when you confirm).
Many LSPDFR plugins expect RAGENativeUI.dll to already be present before you go on duty.

guides.title: Damage Tracker Framework
steps: The author hosts this on LCPDFR.com (login required). This manager cannot fetch that zip for you.
Download it yourself, then drop the zip on Smart Install — Duty folder only.
DamageTrackerLib.dll goes next to RagePluginHook.exe. DamageTrackerFramework.dll goes in Plugins\ so RAGE Plugin Hook can start it.
Policing Redefined needs this running before you go on duty.
